scope: Maximum currently reusable public-data resolution of the orientation-climate correspondence without pooling incompatible phylogenetic markers or lowering source/taxon identity guards.

headline.interpretation: Downward/nodding orientation remains associated with higher precipitation seasonality across source expansion, strict coordinate-quality harmonization, genuine public topology uncertainty, covariance-strength sensitivity and within-taxon occurrence resampling. Whether the contrast crosses a P<0.05 threshold is not stable across those admissible analyses. The earlier lower-temperature direction is not comparably robust after the expanded n=12 panel and genuine topology uncertainty are propagated.

critical_correction.old_statement: six AU-nonrejected optimized Comp1061 trees supplied six ecology-panel topology sensitivities
critical_correction.corrected_statement: all six AU-nonrejected trees, and all nine optimized candidates, induce the same topology after pruning to the n=9, n=11 and n=12 ecology panels; they are branch-length/candidate sensitivities rather than six distinct ecology topologies
replacement_topology_layers: ASTRAL-III reconstructed from all 153 public locus trees
independent Chang et al. 2026 ASTRAL topology

ufboot.branch_length_status: raw IQ-TREE .ufboot topology only; equal branches used

direct_tbn_native.note: Earlier direct-native and exact-name TBN tiers crossed or approached the fixed threshold but are not selected as primary after observing results.

taxonomic_guards: C. albescens mapped only to the predeclared C. japonicum var. albescens concept and constrained to its documented southern-Taiwan geography
C. japonicum var. fukienense parent lookup admitted only occurrence-level names explicitly containing the fukienense concept and documented island/region guards
C. pengii has no surrogate mapping

tbia.result: all tested documented production URL forms returned HTTP 404 even for the documentation positive control
tbia.boundary: not interpreted as zero focal records; dev host and portal scraping are not substituted

coordinate_quality_harmonization.rule: all GBIF/TBN cells require explicit coordinate uncertainty <=10 km; no missing-uncertainty fallback
coordinate_quality_harmonization.interpretation: BIO15 direction survives a single stricter coordinate-quality rule, but threshold support does not.

covariance_strength_sensitivity.interpretation: BIO15 sign is not generated by fixing Brownian covariance at lambda=1; threshold strength is much more sensitive to occurrence coverage/quality than to lambda within these species-tree branch geometries.

joint_occurrence_topology_uncertainty.interpretation: BIO15 direction survives joint sampling uncertainty of taxon niche centroids and genuine topology uncertainty, while the fraction of nominally significant fits changes strongly. BIO1 does not retain the same cross-layer direction in broad n=12.

resolved: lack of substantive ecology-panel diversity among the old six AU candidate trees
topology robustness of BIO15 across concatenated bootstrap, locus-tree and coalescent/external species-tree layers
failure of BIO1 to remain an equally robust ecological axis
source and coordinate-quality sensitivity of threshold-level support
unresolved: historical niche at individual orientation transitions
whether precipitation seasonality acts through rainfall/wetting, correlated topography/temperature, pollinator presentation or another covariate
not_evaluable: phyllary climate correspondence under current state-diverse overlap
stickiness climate correspondence under current state-diverse overlap

claim_boundary: The strongest admissible Chapter 2 ecological statement is a direction-robust but inferential-strength-sensitive present-day association between downward/nodding orientation and higher precipitation seasonality. Do not call it adaptation, historical climate causation, event-specific convergence, a transition rate, or proof of a rainfall mechanism. BIO1 should not be presented as equally robust.
